messages:
lina: Quick RFC follow-up: propose a RAM-only verifier for air-gapped upgrades that streams chunked artifacts, writes only a tiny activation marker, and emits a compact attestation receipt on reconnect.

nora: TL;DR: no persistent signing keys, resumable installs via chunk index, atomic activation via symlink+marker, minimal receipt for control-plane validation.

jorge: How do we prevent replayed older media?

lina: anchors include a monotonic sequence and release epoch. verifier rejects manifests with older sequence numbers unless operator override flag present.

anya: Recovery on power-loss?

nora: verifier streams chunks into a staging overlay and maintains a chunk bitmap; if power fails before marker durable, boot ignores staged path. resume uses bitmap to skip applied chunks.

jorge: What about rollback speed?

lina: manifest flag "retain_previous": N keeps prior chunk indexes (or blobs) to speed revert. tradeoff: disk. we can also support "index-only" fast-rollback that rehydrates from media.

anya: telemetry concerns on reconnect? don't leak env details.

nora: receipt contains staged_id, result, applied_roots, verifier_pub, and a nonce. serialized compactly (protobuf-lite). control-plane validates signature against bundled anchors. no runtime env strings.

ops-bot: action: draft RFC + PoC ticket in eng-infra repo. owners: @lina, @jorge. due: 2026-04-20.

lina: I'll draft the RFC with sequence diagram, manifest schema, threat model, and sample proto. review request tomorrow. :thumbsup:
